acceptance_rule.per_case: PASS iff every asserted field matches the frozen expectation; numeric tolerance 1e-9; verdicts, labels and booleans exact.
acceptance_rule.gate: W1 analytical correctness is SUPPORTED only if 14/14 planned cases PASS and the unit test suite returns 0.

resource_limits.stage_cap: W0-W1 combined: one working day and 30 CPU minutes

prohibited_and_not_performed: SUMO invocation or any simulator episode
import or execution of any legacy runtime module
unattended campaigns, heartbeats or automatic retries
editing the frozen fixture to match implementation output
